verdict.rationale: Anthropic's docs claim Claude (the built-in assistant) automatically detects and loads relevant skills to handle delegated tasks, or can be invoked directly via /skill-name (anthropic-skills-docs-2, anthropic-skills-docs-25). However, hands-on/independent evidence concretely contradicts the automatic-delegation claim: Vercel's evaluation found skills were never invoked in 56% of relevant cases with no improvement over baseline, and multiple practitioners report skills are 'hit or miss' or nearly impossible to trigger even when explicitly relevant (anthropic-skills-comm-7, anthropic-skills-comm-8, anthropic-skills-comm-9). Missing for 10: reliable automatic task delegation without manual invocation, independent benchmarks showing consistent trigger accuracy, resolution of the documented invocation-failure reports.
